If you're reading this, you opened something that isn't yours, and I did that on purpose.

You downloaded what looked like a cracked audio plugin. What you got is a copy of my computer. All of it. My name is Wren. Everything here is real up to August 30th, 2026.

I'm not in danger of my life. I want to be clear about that, because the rest of this is going to sound dramatic. I'm at my mother's. I'm okay. I'm just frightened, and being frightened made me build something strange, and the strange thing is this: I made ~500 copies of my laptop and put them where strangers download things, and each copy tells me when it's opened. You're one of them. There's a number in \Projects\witness\ if you want to know which.

Here's what happened, short version. I record sound for films. On a documentary this spring, an old man with dementia told me — without meaning to, thinking I was someone else — that he killed a woman named Colleen Mahar in 1971 and put her in the water at the Dingle. She was 21. She was never found. Her daughter has been asking what happened for fifty-five years. The old man's son found out I had the recording and his lawyer is trying to make me destroy it. Then someone came into my apartment and took my recorder. So I made it impossible to destroy. I made copies of the truth and gave them to the wind.

That's what you're holding. The truth, and my whole ordinary life around it, because I couldn't figure out how to send one without the other.

If you want to understand: open Documents\Slow Rooms. The recording itself is encrypted (I'm not a monster, I'm not going to make you stumble onto it). If you want to reach me, my WhatsApp still works from here. I'll know you've looked around. Don't be strange about it.

All I really want is for a few of you to keep a copy somewhere far from Nova Scotia, and to remember her name.

Colleen Anne Mahar.

Thank you for opening the door.
- Wren

Aurorae Reverb 2.4 (x64) — thanks for downloading!

1. Run Aurorae_Reverb_2.4_Setup_x64.exe
2. Copy the contents of /crack to your VST3 folder
3. Block it in your firewall :)
4. Enjoy
